text:
deploybot: Scheduled rollout: v2 -> edge proxies. Start=2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Initial traffic: 10% global, canary on eu-west. Monitor: latency_p95 < 120ms, 5xx < 0.2%. Pins: mobile-sdk tenants: tenant-42, tenant-99 (do not shift). Release notes draft at https://rwd.in/release/notes/v2-draft :eyes:
anya: ack. who's owning release notes sign-off? I can shepherd if needed. :wave:
mike.s: SRE/infra checks done? proxies warmed, canaries built?
julia_p: infra did a warmup yesterday, kernel patch applied to edge boxes. autoscaler policy for v2 is same as v1.
sre-bot: deploywatch: preflight OK. watch windows: first 15m high-fidelity, then 1h loose. Alerts set for 4xx/5xx spikes and latency regressions.
ops-tilly: opshandoff doc updated and shared. I'll be on call for the window.
deploybot: rollout command queued. Operator checklist: 1) confirm pin list 2) release notes posted 3) monitoring dashboards open 4) operator eyes on canary. Run command: ```/deploy v2 --pct 10 --edge-probe eu-west --pins tenant-42,tenant-99 --notes-url https://rwd.in/release/notes/v2-draft```
anya: confirmed pin list. release notes updated with breaking-change note about header-case normalisation.
mike.s: quick reminder: if we see client pin signals (x-client-version: old) we delay shift. threshold: >1% pinned traffic in first 5m -> pause.
10m later
anya: deploybot: executing rollout now.
deploybot: start: shifting 10% traffic to /api/v2 across selected edges. logs: proxy-sync ok, route-table updated.
sre-bot: alert: high 5xx rate on edge eu-west (0.9%) sustained 2m. linked alert: https://rwd.in/alerts/ALRT-2301
mike.s: I'm seeing increased 502s between edge and model pool, looks like connection resets from bender-proxy group.
julia_p: rolling back proxy kernel tweak on a subset to test.
ops-tilly: pausing rollout? we should hold until we confirm scope.
anya: pausing rollout. deploybot: pause command?
deploybot: acknowledged. Action: pausing further percentage increases. Current 10% remains pinned while we triage.
sre-bot: additional telemetry: origin latency to model pool spiked 4x around the time of shift. Not all regions affected.
mike.s: recommend rollback to v1 for impacted edge pool (eu-west) to remove degradation signal. rollback criteria met: 5xx > 0.5% for 3m on a canary region.
julia_p: agree. I can flip the edge routing for eu-west to v1. ops-tilly, can you coordinate on tenant impact?
ops-tilly: will notify mobile on-call and tenant owners. tenant-42/99 are pinned so unaffected. others we will map to traffic percentages.
deploybot: performing partial rollback: eu-west edge pool -> v1. Command: ```/deploy rollback --region eu-west --target v1 --reason "edge 5xx spike during v2 canary"```
anya: rolling release notes to note the pause and affected region.
15m later
deploybot: rollback complete for eu-west. 5xx for eu-west back to baseline (0.03%). Global v2 exposure now 6% (traffic redistributed away from eu-west).
mike.s: confirming latency and errors look normal. marking canary as failed for eu-west. Need root-cause.
julia_p: early hypothesis: connection pooling + header normalization in v2 exposed a proxy keepalive bug, reproducing in staging now.
ops-tilly: operator postmortem checklist: collect traces, heap/conn stats for bender-proxy, dump proxy logs for 02:00-02:20 window. I'll create a follow-up thread.
anya: for release cadence: propose we hold full rollout until the fix/retest. also update release notes to call out the header change and recommended client upgrade.
sre-bot: clearing canary 'eyes' and marking rollout paused. State saved: rollout_id=rbld-1776543210, pause=true.
deploybot: leaving the rollout paused. To resume: `/deploy resume rollout_id=rbld-1776543210 --approve @lead-eng @sre`
mike.s: adding rollback acceptance criteria in the ticket. If root cause fix takes >24h we schedule a staged drain and warmup plan.
julia_p: ack. will post repro steps and test build in the ticket.
ops-tilly: tenant notification: sent to owners, internal comms ready.
anya: thanks all. I'll update the release notes and close the loop once we have a clean staging pass. :thumbsup:
